title: RBG counsel decisions (human-filled)
description: Schema for docs/release/legal-review/counsel-decisions.json. Automation must never fabricate decisions. A decision on one component must not approve unrelated components.

decision_id.description: Stable unique id for this decision record (e.g. CD-DEC-2026-001).

counsel_decision_id.description: Exact tip-file group id from counsel-decision-manifests.json (CD-RG-NNN).

review_group_id.description: Optional alias; validator normalizes to CD-{review_group_id}.

artifact_id.description: Legacy PH-14 pack id (CS-NNNN). Does not clear tip-file CD-* groups.

reviewer_id.description: Must match active counsel entry in authorized-reviewers.json for positive decisions.

decided_at.description: ISO date or datetime of the human decision.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry; past dates invalidate positive decisions.

scope_sha256.description: Must equal manifest scope_sha256 for the exact member list.

compatible_policy_tree_sha.description: Must match manifest compatible_policy_tree_sha when present.

members.description: Optional explicit file list; if present must equal manifest members.

evidence_refs.description: Required for positive decisions (memo, ticket, license notice paths).

clears_product_restriction.description: Must be false or omitted. SOURCE counsel ≠ LOCAL_ONLY/BLOCKED product clearance.
